Mellin-Poisson closes that scalar descent. The still-missing level-four-to-level-one mate must compare this line-valued defect to the independently bounded seam/Green incidence; it is not generated automatically by the failure.

falsifier: Any proposed C_FP lower row obtained only by choosing representatives of P1 or P2 in a Hilbert space is frame-dependent: finite counterterms move between those lines while preserving Xi. conclusion: The first failed triangular operation is now typed: one cannot form and eliminate the primitive, square, and connected Euler columns as a single completed vector. But that failure is already exactly the determinant anomaly-line construction supplying scalar Xi. It does not by itself construct conservative feedback. The missing fourth-to-first wrap is a natural transformation from this line-valued anomaly complex to the bounded positive Green complex.
